title: The 3rd box... so far even better!
text: More good stuff coming.  I love this. I actually will use everything in this kit.  Yay! The advantage Amazon boxes had was the credit...Allure did send discounts for all these products but they expired before my kit got here, so not sure what's up with that.  Will "see what happens" with the next one, to quote our 46th President.  I have full samples of lipsticks and blusher which I thought was a horrible shade, turned out great on the face.  Serums, the nail polish which I am very particular about is a spot on classic but in style shade, I will use that for my pedicures and bring to the salon. I wear gel nails and don't usually use nail polish samples. (perfumes please, for the handbag or travel)  Well worth the 15 dollars.  I haven't bought much makeup lately besides my  fundamentals of foundation (Chanel for winter and a SPF sheer La Rouche-Possy face tint for summer)  Not much is going to shake me for routine skin care from the Neutrogena Hydro gel line...amazing for drugstore prices.  No regrets, keep an open mind and have fun.  I posted a pic of my Irish green eye skin and hair colors in summer with some color for reference, in case you wondered.  I am sure we all have different concerns. I am 56 years old and a professional woman with a major beach bum problem.  LOL
label: positive
